newsitem.title: UK: Slovenia mandates CSFB, DKB to lead debut mark bond.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia mandates CSFB, DKB to lead debut mark bond.

text.p: Slovenia has mandated Credit Suisse First Boston and Dresdner Kleinwort Benson to lead manage its debut Eurobond in marks, CSFB said in a statement on Friday.
Slovenia is rated A3 by Moody's Investors Service, A by Standard & Poor's Corp and A- by IBCA.
The Ministry of Finance will hold investor presentations in key financial centres prior to the launch of the transaction, the statement said.
It said timing, size and maturity of the transaction would be announced shortly after the launch of the transaction.
Syndicate officials said Slovenia had taken bids for a mark deal, at five-, seven- and 10-year maturities.
Last July, Slovenia launched a debut Eurobond issue via J.P. Morgan.
The $325 million five-year deal was priced to yield 58 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes, at the time the tightest spread for any Eurobond out of Eastern Europe.
